ink.$description: Ink — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills, list backgrounds

warm-shell.$description: Warm Shell — Hero gradient base, secondary surfaces — the warm cream that gives the whole site its sunset atmosphere

driftwood.$description: Driftwood — Muted body text, subtle borders, image shadows — warm gray that harmonizes with the peach canvas

smoke.$description: Smoke — Nav text, icon strokes, list borders, secondary text

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text at reduced contrast, fine borders in content blocks

iron.$description: Iron — Deeper secondary text, fine separator borders

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, light dividers between sections and cards

electric-lime.$description: Electric Lime — Green accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

lavender-whisper.$description: Lavender Whisper — Outlined action borders, ghost button strokes, soft decorative accents — a desaturated violet that signals interactivity without shouting

lilac-mist.$description: Lilac Mist — Decorative pastel wash, soft card accents, illustration tints

blossom.$description: Blossom — Decorative pastel wash, hero gradient highlight, soft illustration tint

plum-shadow.$description: Plum Shadow — Deep accent in image shadows and illustration depth — gives floating islands their grounded dimensionality

dusk-gradient.$description: Dusk Gradient — Gradient endpoint for dark image overlays

aurora-wash.$description: Aurora Wash — Subtle multi-hue gradient wash on feature sections — used at 0.08 opacity for atmospheric backgrounds

p22-mackinac-pro.$description: Display headlines and editorial accents. Weight 300-400 at 60-96px creates the signature warm, literary feel — the serif whispers rather than commands. Italic variant used for emphasis words in headlines ('actually', 'Statamic').

lexend.$description: Primary UI and body typeface. Nav, buttons, body text, card titles, footer. Weight 300 for nav and secondary text keeps the interface light; 500-600 for buttons and labels. The wide weight range lets it carry both quiet metadata and confident CTAs.

code-saver.$description: Monospace for code blocks, file tree, technical content, input fields. Weight 700 for syntax emphasis, 300 for ambient code display.

lore.$description: Icon font — single weight at 14px for UI iconography
